correctness.rationale: For bidirected K_2,6 each legal arc set has indegree/outdegree at most one and no directed cycle; at most four arcs can be selected. Independent enumeration generated f=(24,192,600,600). Each of 793 recorded Morse operations was checked independently: 623 free-face/coface removals and 170 maximal critical removals, with one critical vertex and 169 critical tetrahedra, 0 unmatched faces, and acyclic complete 1416-face directed Hasse orientation. Hence X6 is integral wedge of 169 S3 and two-connected. An independent exact mod2 boundary-rank computation for n=1..6 showed nonzero reduced H0,H1 or H2 for all n<=5, proving sharpness (not relying on absence of a low-dimensional matching alone).

originality.rationale: Closest bidirected multipath paper classifies polygonal digraphs, i.e. paths and cycles; an undirected K2,6 has multiple 4-cycles and is not in that family. Prior one-way complete bipartite theorem computes a different multipath complex because the orientation lacks reverse arcs and directed 2-cycles. The submitted threshold and exact 169-sphere homotopy were not implied by the inspected theorems.
